Anyhow.
Lucille was losing it.
Her hands flew to her head, gripping her own hair like she was about to rip it out.
Kitsara, meanwhile, was grinning like a demon, watching Lucille spiral into complete despair.
She folded her arms smugly in front of her sensual chest, tails swaying behind her as she let out a satisfied hum.
"Hmph.
Well, well, well... looks like someone slipped up badly."
Lucille snapped her head at her, looking one step away from committing a very serious crime.
"You.
Accursed woman.
Shut your trap."
Kitsara just flicked her ears in response, looking way too pleased with herself.
Curiously, I looked at her status with [Slave Monitor] and saw that her class hadn't changed; she was still a Nine-Tailed Sorceress.

I found it odd, thinking she somehow might've failed and wasted the unique opportunity Rosie provided all of us with, but then, my eyes traveled toward her sensual bottom that was swaying left and right out of pure amusement at the situation.
There, my eyes spied not one, not two, but three lush, white-furred, rapidly wagging tails.
Back when we met for the first time, she only had one tail, which didn't grant her many abilities.
Her main spell was [Veil of Deception], allowing her to alter her appearance at will, including voice and scent, but she could not change size or mass in any significant manner.
I couldn't help but wonder just what kind of illusionist abilities she'd unlocked after getting two tails in the span of two days.
*Clap!*
I clapped my hands together, gathering everyone's attention.
"Rosie, stop tormenting your mothers."
"Okay, Daddy!" she purred immediately, ceasing the act and zooming toward me with breakneck speed.

After the little lady seated herself on my shoulder and gave my cheek a long, loud, and quite the possessive peck, I continued, addressing the women who were currently gawking at Rosie as if she were the devil herself after realizing they'd been thoroughly played.
"Ladies, we have a few hours until we have to depart.
Use this time to familiarize yourselves with your new classes.
[Warp Gate].
If you need space to experiment, step through.
I'll pick you up when it's time."
They did as they were asked after a bit of grumbling thanks to Rosie, who pretended not to hear them because she was singing to herself.
"Rosie, I want you to stay behind.
War is not for children to partake in."
Her attitude immediately shifted once the words left my mouth.
Her smile disappeared, replaced by anxious, begging puppy eyes.
"Must you leave?" She strengthened her weak arms around my skull, not wanting to let go.
Your father and mothers have chosen a difficult path for themselves," I admitted in a serious tone.
"Instead of playing things safe, we've decided to shoot for the stars."
"Instead of playing things safe..." she repeated before protesting, "Daddy is already plenty strong!
You don't need to take so many risks!"
I shook my head.
"Just today, our home was uh... 'found and entered' by Lady Yoruha and Celeste.
As our luck would have it, they turned out to be kind people, but what if they had been hostile?
I'm not strong enough to protect you from beings of their power level just yet.
That's why I must leave and become powerful enough to protect all who I care about."
"Rosie doesn't need to be protected!
Instead, she'll protect Daddy from enemies!"
How adorable...
I didn't know what to do besides giving the teary girl a few big loving headpats.
As I was doing that, a muted whisper left her lips.
"Rosie can't leave, even if she was allowed to..."
"Hmm?"
"Rosie is linked to her tree...
Her body is sustained through that link.
She needs to grow stronger before she can go far enough to protect Daddy from his enemies..."
Well, then we got no choice.
Rosie must grow stronger so she can protect me, and in the meantime, I'll grow stronger so I can protect you.
We each have a difficult task ahead of us."
"Hehe..." she giggled, swiping a tear from her eyes with her little finger as her mood visibly brightened.
"Rosie will grow much bigger and stronger!" she declared while flexing her two biceps at me.
Naturally, no musculature showed.
That didn't seem to disturb her, however.
"She'll become strong enough to restrain Daddy so he can't leave without Rosie's permission!"
I'm not sure if that's..." I muttered wryly but then shrugged my shoulders.
"Eh, what matters is that you found your motivation, I suppose."
A beaming, proud, and eager smile was all the response I received.
The following few hours passed quickly.
I checked on my estate, seeing if the construction workers had everything they needed.
Now that I became the Avatar of the Elements, I could also change the terrain in significant ways, such as the bath I made so I could molest Vex- I mean, help my ladies bathe.
As such, I informed Ronan and Iselda to make plans for that, but I didn't make any changes for now.
Rushing wasn't an option, for when it came to my home, I wanted it to be perfect.
I spent the remaining time playing with Rosie.
Unlike Blossom, I wasn't kind enough to keep letting her win, earning myself many strong pouts in return.
Soon, it was time.
After handing the slumbering Yoruha over to Celeste, I opened a [Warp Gate] to the room we left from in the dogkin palace, and all of us stepped through.
An unexpected welcome awaited my arrival in the form of a coyly purring voice.
"Future hubby..."

chapters.title: Chapter 699: Return to Canisgard
paragraphs: "Future hubby..." Vex purred after I stepped through the [Warp Gate]. She was sitting on our bed elegantly, with one leg crossed over the other. Her kendo-style dress was covering most of her legs, only giving me a minute glance of her ankles.
"Future wife, it's good to see you," I replied. Thankfully, my mask was obstructing my surprised face. I didn't expect her to barge into our room while we were away.

"You left to have fun without me...?" I didn't know how this monster could possibly have the gall to act as if she were an abandoned puppy. Her dejected tone and droopy eyes wordlessly accused me of many atrocities.
"I mean, if you want to participate in our next day-long orgy session, you're more than welcome."
Her expression immediately underwent a great shift upon hearing my words, and she looked at me with a deadpan face. "Men... Level up, eat tasty meals, have sex, repeat. Is this all you think about?"
Kitsara replied in my stead with a question of her own. "Is there something else to think about?"

"It's good to have you back, princess..." Vex muttered dryly, visibly not used to a lady being so open about her animalistic needs and desires. As far as having a loose mouth filter went, Kitsara could easily give Vex a good run for her money. At least, so long as her father wasn't present. She seemed to be a bit shy in front of Vargis.
Vex's attitude shifted as she looked at our entourage. "Miss Ambition is here as well. Hi! I see you brought a new face as well," she said while eyeing Sylvaris.
After collecting herself from shock, the Mooncaller had consumed Rosie's final flower gift, becoming a Moonblessed Warden. Despite the class's name, it wasn't all about defense.

As for the flowers that grew on Rosie's branches, they hadn't been ruined, but each flower could only be used once. After a person inhales their fragrance into their lungs, they lose their magical properties. She had to grow new flowers, but she didn't know how long doing so would take.

"Greetings, Lady Vex. Please call me Moon," Sylvaris replied. Despite Vex knowing my name and quite a few more details, that didn't mean I trusted Black Fang enough to become an open book for them. As such, we decided to keep as many secrets as possible, we were all wearing our masks as well.
"You have a beautiful voice, Moon." Vex's aforementioned loose-mouth filter was already on full display. She often said whatever was on her mind even when it wasn't fitting the situation.

"Although I'm happy to welcome you into my bedroom at any time, would you care to elaborate on why you're here?" I asked, helping my mother-in-law so she did not have to deal with this eccentric woman.
"Oh! I waited for such a long time I almost forgot."

Vex grinned wickedly as she reached into her storage ring, pulling out two severed heads by their hair. She lifted them with the utmost casualness, as if they were nothing more than discarded trophies. The first belonged to Ryker while the second was Chicken, the annoying bitch of a woman who constantly manipulated the aforementioned man. Her features were twisted in the agony of her final moments, telling tales of an end that didn't end all too quickly.
The difference between the expressions of the two faces told me Ryker had met a swift end while Chicken, well... Not so much. Vex also found her irritating, it seemed.
A faint smirk lingered on Vex's lips as she examined them together with us before turning her gaze to me.

"Now that Maelstrom is in beastman lands, unless you want the whole Vesper Consortium to know you're more than a human with the Elemental Sovereign class, these lovely people were nothing more than hindrances. They would've snitched on you."

She tilted her head to the side. Her crimson eyes glinted with amusement while her lips curled up into the cruel, sadistic smile I'd seen in a while. Her current face reminded me of the time she sentenced Kael the Cryomancer to death with a euphoric scream. "Aren't I such a perfect, caring future wife? While my man-to-be was away rolling in bedsheets, I took it upon myself to clean house."
My heart skipped a beat.
"Damn, woman. You're so beautiful when you smile like that."

Vex's expression immediately brightened into a dazzling beam, looking genuinely pleased with the compliment. Meanwhile, every other person in the room stared at me in pure deadpan silence, not understanding what I found sexy in this evil woman.
Vex placed the heads back into her ring to be discarded later, not wanting to litter the dogkin royal palace.
"What's next?" I asked. With the deal between the Consortium and the Beastman Confederation secured, our diplomatic mission had been concluded.
We could officially return home right this moment and celebrate a mission success. However, none of us wanted to do that. Well, besides Ignis, perhaps.

Vex was all about killing the lionkin, while Raika was a battle-crazed woman who would never turn down a challenge this exciting. As for us, our primary goal was to save Blossom's sister and mother, who were enslaved by the yellow kittens, but we also wanted to farm XP and souls and lastly also help Kitsara's family in their war effort. While Ignis... He was along for the ride, I suppose.

"I believe we have two reasonable routes," Vex replied. "Either join Maelstrom and become part of the giant Consortium army or remain with the dogkin and help the beastkin side instead. We could go in our lonesome, but doing so wouldn't be smart. While it's true that I'm not only incredibly beautiful but also very strong, I'm not powerful enough to beat the strongest lionkin or Covenant members, especially if they gang up on us... If we run into them, it might be over for most of us."
I nodded in understanding. "The Consortium or the beastkin, huh...?"
It was a hard choice. Both had many pros and cons.
Vex cleared her throat with a sly smirk. "Khm! The Consortium will most likely be facing the Covenant and their giant undead hordes."
"I and my allies strongly suggest we stay with the beastkin."

My instant reply earned me an amused giggle from the white-haired babe sitting in front of us. "Mr. Devil, I feel like your decision has something to do with your knowledge that undead minions grant no XP."
"A wild and wholly baseless accusation."
"Is that so...? Well, you won't find me complaining. I would much rather butcher lionkin than crush undead monstrosities."
The two of us nodded at each other in sync, reaching a state of perfect mutual agreement.
With that, we left to greet my father-in-law.

We made our way through the grand halls of the Dogkin Palace. The deeper we went, the quieter it became. At the heart of it all was Vargis's study, a war room more than a place of leisure, where the true command of the dogkin forces took shape.

Upon arrival, most of the party remained outside, chatting idly or sharpening their minds in preparation for the coming war. Only Vex, Kitsara, and I stepped forward, pushing open the heavy wooden doors and stepping inside.

chapters.title: Chapter 700: Time for War
paragraphs: The room was dimly lit, creating a rather cozy atmosphere, illuminated by a few lanterns and the blue glow of a large communication artifact at the center of the large war table. Unlike the portable one I had, this one was embedded into the middle of the table itself. Vargis stood at the head of the aforementioned table with his arms crossed. Beside him were his two sons.
Darius, the first prince, was a towering warrior with scars marking his body like trophies, his expression always set in a grim scowl, greatly resembling his father.
Fenrik, the second prince, was slightly leaner and sharper-eyed, striking me as more of a tactician than a purebred warrior.

The trio were locked in discussion, their gazes fixed on the glowing artifact, from which a voice came through—a deep, commanding tone belonging to none other than Maelstrom, the Vesper Consortium's army general.

"We're en route. Our forces will step into lionkin lands within the hour," Maelstrom reported. His voice carried the weight of thousands of marching troops, an army large enough to crush cities. "What's your status?"

Vargis leaned forward to press his fingers against the map, where various pieces marked out the current positions of the beastkin alliance and lionkin forces. "We're ready to move out at a moment's notice. The bulk of our army will advance along the eastern path, pushing into their border defenses. We expect resistance, but with the Consortium drawing their attention from the west and the other beastkin from the north, we have good reason to believe they'll struggle to defend all borders."
Fenrik tapped the map. "That's assuming they don't have any nasty surprises waiting. The Covenant's been quiet despite knowing their high-ranking member has been compromised."
"Understood. We're continuing our march. Maelstrom out."
With that, the blue light of the artifact ceased shining, letting the lanterns be the sole source of illumination.
"Daughter, you're back," Vargis grunted.
"Hello!" she replied with a cheery smile, perfectly ignoring that her father was visibly unhappy with her day-long disappearance.
"That reminds me, what about the necromancer? Her large army was standing still in the lionkin lands."

My question was met with Vex's coy chuckle. "A lot of things happened in the past day, Mr. Devil. While you were conducting a day-long orgy with your ladies, we killed the necromancer to set her army free before the Covenant got to them. They're rampaging through the lionkin lands now."

Three heads snapped in Kitsara's direction, making the usually shameless woman burst out into a strong shade of pink all across her cheeks. Her ears twitched as she cried out in alarm, protesting Vex's antics. "N-not in front of my family!"

"Nice job, little sis. I'm happy for you; you finally found a man for yourself. I was getting worried you would become a lesbo like those long-eared sluts," Darius smirked with a thumbs up, earning himself a mighty strong growl from Vargis who eyed me like he was debating whether he should tear me apart or just beat me to a pulp. He was still struggling with letting his beloved little princess go, it seemed.

As for what Darius meant with the lesbian long-eared remark, thanks to Malakar killing the first male elf, the male elves got a 'little bit' nerfed, making them die much sooner than female elves. As such, many of them opted to become lesbians, not wanting to get heartbroken by losing their lovers early.
Anyhow. Knowing we were about to move out, I addressed my father-in-law. "Papa Vargis, this kind, humble, and loving son of yours would like to ask a big favor."
"No," he grunted without even hearing me out.

I ignored him. "My allies and I would like to gain access to your armory, our gear is lacking a bit." Back when I joined the resistance armies, I thought beastkin didn't like using weapons and armor due to their great pride, but as it would turn out, that was only true for the apex races that had great innate physical advantages.

The dogkin and foxkin, as well as other non-apexes, had no issue using weapons and armor. Their stuff wasn't as great as what could be found in the other two countries for they lacked good artificers, but I thought I might as well rummage through his properties in search of a few good pieces.
His lips twitched in sheer irritation. "Aren't you adored by that Black Fang woman? Go ask your sugar mommy."
"Now-now, Papa Vargis. Unlike you, Lady Black Fang is not family. She expects I return the favor, and I already owe her for the 500 gold I asked from her."
"Sucks to be you."
"Father, stop being so antagonistic... Just because he rummaged Kitsara to his heart's content doesn't make this guy your enemy," Darius spoke up in my defense.
"B-brother! Stop messing with me!" my foxkin lover cried in protest but only received a second smug smirk.
A fierce staredown followed between the cheiftain and first prince, after which a conclusion was reached. We were allowed to take one item each.
I thanked the surprisingly friendly dogkin with a warm nod of my head, which he returned.

We departed for the armory, and as expected, they didn't have any exemplary pieces lying around. Whatever they took off of dwarves and other enemies were already in use, given to some of their mightiest warriors. We were glad to take some freebies, nonetheless.

Afterward, we rejoined the royal family, who headed to the large army stationed outside Canisgard, the dogkin capital city. This army consisted of about 20,000 dogkin warriors. The size of this force wasn't as big as the Consortium's, which could be best explained by the fact that the syndicate had been lying low for eternity, peacefully building their forces, while the beastkin were fighting other countries as well as their neighboring beastkin.
Anyhow. It was finally time to participate in my life's first-ever large-scale war, and boy... What an experience this one would end up becoming.
